description.value: White Spot is BC's longest-running restaurant chain, operating since 1928 and known for its classic burgers made with fresh Canadian beef and locally sourced ingredients. This Surrey location is a full-service family restaurant offering breakfast, lunch, and dinner in a sit-down setting. Touring cyclists will find a familiar, accessible stop with takeout options available.
